sourceFacts.fact: People with CF do not reabsorb salt well from sweat ducts.

sources.title: Cystic Fibrosis Foundation: Top 5 Tips to Stay Healthy This Summer

sourceFacts.fact: Sweat chloride is measured by quantitative pilocarpine iontophoresis.

sources.title: Cystic Fibrosis Foundation: Sweat Test Clinical Care Guidelines

targetQuestion: Why is sweat salty in cystic fibrosis?
targetAnswer: Less chloride is reabsorbed in the sweat duct.

edges.meaning: Solid arrow: chloride reabsorption with functioning CFTR
Thin dashed arrow: reduced chloride reabsorption with impaired CFTR
